The '''Old World''', also known as the '''Undercity''', was the name given to the first [[City/Legends|city]] built by the [[Eternal Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]].

==Description==
{{Quote|This is the Old World as most Zakuulans know it--a place to mingle with the rabble and then go home to brag about it.|Senya Tirall|<ref name="KotFE 7" />}}
The Old World was located at the surface of the planet Zakuul,<ref name="KotFE 7" /> at the foot of [[Spire (Zakuul)|the Spire]],<ref name="TOR:TS">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|The Spire}}</ref> and above [[District 1327|Breaktown]]. The Undercity was rather different from the Spire whose inhabitants lived in a near-utopia. As the Eternal Empire security forces were virtually absent from the area, alternative economy prospered in the Old World. Largely controlled by criminals, the area provided unsavoury services that were absent in the Spire. The Undercity had therefore acquired a nefarious reputation and became a place to visit for the privileged Zakuulans who were fascinated by suffering but did not really know much about it. Nevertheless, despite its nefarious reputation, the Undercity remained a quite safe place, especially compared to Breaktown.<ref name="TOR:TOW" /> Ironically, Spire denizens continuously brag about venturing in the Old World as a feat<ref name="KotFE 7" /> while most of them visited Oldtown in their life.<ref name="TOR:TS" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Heralds run the Old World now. They made a deal. Heralds keep crime down, and the Knights keep out.|[[Reg]]|<ref name="KotFE 7" />}}
[[File:Surface_of_Zakuul.jpg|thumb|300px|The Old World seen from the surface of Zakuul]]
The Old World was built by Emperor [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] amid the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the planet Zakuul. Despite the construction of the city was a real success, it was not grand enough for the Emperor, so a second metropolis&mdash;the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]]&mdash;was built atop the Old World. Sections of the Old World around the Spire's base remained intact and inhabited.<ref name="KotFE 7" />

During the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]] allowed the fanatical [[Heralds of Zildrog]] to take over the Old World in order to keep order in area in place of the [[Knights of Zakuul]].<ref name="KotFE 7" /><ref name="TOR:HoZ">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Heralds of Zildrog}}</ref>

During that conflict, the [[Alliance Commander]] visited the Old World twice: in the company of [[Senya Tirall]] while looking for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]]<ref name="KotFE 7" /> in [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates 4.0">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> and in the company of [[Kaliyo Djannis]] while planting explosives at the power junctions in preparation for their [[Raid on the Overwatch|assault]] on the [[Overwatch]]<ref name="KotFE 10" /> in [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="TOR_updates 4.1">{{TOR_updates|4.1}}</ref>
